tasks.title: Seeded randomness
tasks.note:
REJECTED
- hpq/tests/SeedTest.cpp: Seed.RepaintingTheSameDeviceDoesNotKeepThePreviousBrushAlpha would still pass if `m_brush_alpha = 255` were removed from reset_painter_state(). The engine reads m_brush_alpha only when m_has_brush is true, and m_has_brush is only set by DirtyBrush, which sets the alpha too. So the name claims a check the test cannot make. The only thing it can catch is a missing reseed, and Seed.RepaintingTheSameDeviceGivesTheSameImage already catches that -> remove this test, along with its helpers draw_half_transparent_brush_rect and draw_opaque_brush_rect and the `#include <QColor>` added for it. The line `m_brush_alpha = 255;` in hpq/src/HandPaintEngine.cpp can stay, because it keeps the reset equal to QPainter's defaults and has no effect anyone can see.

tasks.title: Theme selection applies the effect to the window
tasks.note:
FAILED
- other: offscreen, after selecting "Sketch", "China Ink" and "Black slate and chalk", the "File" and "Edit" labels are gone from the menu bar in all three themes (empty band in theme fill colour). A small QMainWindow with File/Edit and the Sketch effect on its menu bar shows the same (shots/mb_plain.png vs shots/mb_sketch.png); status bar "Ready" stays visible. Guess: QMenuBar paints its empty area under a clip region that leaves out the items, and the engine ignores clipping, so the fill covers the labels. -> The spec says text passes through, so menu titles should still show. B25 and B26 themselves give the spec result (effects with matching themes on the three widgets; empty central areas #FFFFFF/#F5EFE0/#2F3B33; "None" restores exactly the start grab).
- other: in the themed grabs (offscreen and macOS) graphics-view shapes scrolled out of its viewport are drawn on top of the table and tree views (blue rect and red ellipse over the table, green line over the tree); on macOS a 4th table row and part of the tree are drawn outside their frames. Also from the missing clipping (listed out of scope in the spec). -> A user sees an overlapping, broken layout.
- other: "Black slate and chalk" offscreen: comboBox text, OK/Cancel labels and table header labels are barely visible — light ink text (#F0F0E8) on light Qt bevels, which are cached pixmaps that pass through unchanged. -> Chalk should give readable light text on dark slate.
- other: every start prints "TRACE before setupUi" … "TRACE before scene" on stderr (debug lines in Examples/src/MainWindow.cpp, present before T15). -> The example app should not print debug traces.
- other (native macOS, known limitation): "QMacCGContext:: Unsupported paint engine type 50" printed 1561 times; comboBox frame, checkBox, groupBox frame, button bevels and scroll bars missing in themed grabs. Judged on offscreen.
